steps.title: Our Services
steps.text: We help growing companies get more value from their technology investments. Our team is known for careful, hands-on work, and we stay involved long after the project ends.

steps.sql:
UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Headings', 'joomlaguide-headings', '

Headings give a page an outline that people, search engines and screen readers can follow. They go from Heading 1 to Heading 6.

In this tour you organise the article Our Services into its service lines with headings, preview it, and look at its HTML code.

This tour follows the tutorial 3.2 Headings of the Joomla User Guide.

', 1, '["com_cpanel","com_content"]', 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', 'Joomla User Guide: 3.2 Headings', 1, 1); INSERT INTO `#__guidedtour_steps` (`tour_id`, `title`, `description`, `ordering`, `position`, `target`, `type`, `interactive_type`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `params`) VALUES ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-headings'), 'Content', '

In the menu on the left, click Content.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 1, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-headings'), 'Content › Articles', '

Click Articles in Content.

', 2, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-headings'), 'Open Our Services', '

Click Our Services to open it for editing.

', 3, 'right', '#articleList tbody tr:first-child a[href*="task=article.edit"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-headings'), 'A Heading 2', '

Joomla shows the article title as the Heading 1 of the page. An article has only one Heading 1, so you use Heading 2 and lower.

  1. Click at the end of the opening paragraph and press Enter.
  2. Open the formatting dropdown in the toolbar; it shows Paragraph. An option with an arrow opens a submenu.
  3. Hover over Headings and click Heading 2.
  4. Type Consulting.

Then click Next.

', 4, 'bottom', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-headings'), 'Back to a paragraph', '

Press Enter. The formatting dropdown shows Paragraph again: after a heading the editor goes back to a paragraph by itself.

Type:

We help you decide what to build, and in what order, before any code is written.

Then click Next.

', 5, 'bottom', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-headings'), 'A Heading 3 from the popup toolbar', '

Now you make a heading of text you already typed.

  1. Press Enter and type What\'s Included.
  2. Select it. The popup toolbar appears, with the icons H2 and H3.
  3. Click H3. The formatting dropdown now shows Heading 3.

You fill this section with a list in the next tutorial. Click Next.

', 6, 'bottom', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-headings'), 'Complete the outline', '

Add the other sections the same way. After each line press Enter:

  • Heading 2: Implementation
  • Paragraph: Our delivery team turns your plan into working software, on time and on budget.
  • Heading 3: Getting Started
  • Heading 2: Support
  • Paragraph: Once you\'re live, we stay close by to keep things running smoothly.

Then click Next.

', 7, 'bottom', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-headings'), 'A quick preview', '

Click the Preview icon of the editor, an eye (in the second row, under ⋯).

A window shows a rough preview of the text in the editor, without the styling of your site: handy to check your outline. Close it with its Close button.

Then click Next.

', 8, 'bottom', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-headings'), 'The Preview button', '

Click Preview at the top of the page.

It shows the article as visitors see it, but as it was last saved: only the opening paragraph. Close the preview with the × at its top right, then click Next.

', 9, 'bottom', '.view-article #toolbar-preview .button-preview', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-headings'), 'Save your progress', '

Click Save, not Save & Close.

Joomla saves the article and you stay in the editor.

', 10, 'bottom', '.view-article #toolbar-apply .button-apply', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-headings'), 'Preview again', '

Click Preview again. Now it shows the whole outline, with its three sections.

Close the preview, then click Next.

', 11, 'bottom', 'body.view-article:has(#system-message-container:not(:empty)) #toolbar-preview .button-preview', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-headings'), 'The HTML code', '
  1. Click Toggle Editor below the text area. The toolbar disappears and you see the HTML code of the article: <h2> and <h3> mark the headings, <p> the paragraphs.
  2. Click Toggle Editor again to get the editor back.

Then click Next.

', 12, 'top', 'body.view-article:has(#system-message-container:not(:empty)) fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-headings'), 'Save the article', '

Click Save & Close.

', 13, 'bottom', '.view-article #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-headings'), 'Well done!', '

Our Services now has an outline of three service sections. Two of them have an empty sub-heading, ready for a list.

You fill them in the next tutorial, Lists.

', 14, 'top', '#articleList tbody tr:first-child', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL);
